questions.q: What problem do Cortex Agents solve that a single AI_COMPLETE or Cortex Analyst call does not?
options: Questions that need multiple tools called in an order that isn't known in advance
Translating text between human languages
Storing data permanently in Snowflake tables
Replacing the need for any SQL warehouse
questions.explain: Cortex Agents orchestrate multiple tool calls — structured queries, unstructured retrieval, custom logic — deciding the sequence dynamically based on the question.

questions.q: What are the three phases of the Cortex Agents reasoning loop?
options: Planning, tool use, and reflection
Login, query, and logout
Extract, transform, and load
Compile, execute, and cache
questions.explain: An agent plans how to approach a request, uses tools to gather information, then reflects on whether it has enough to answer or needs another tool call.

questions.q: Which of these is listed in this lesson as a tool type a Cortex Agent can be configured with?
options: Cortex Search, for retrieval over unstructured text
A dedicated video rendering engine
A spreadsheet macro recorder
A physical printer driver
questions.explain: Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst, code execution, custom tools, MCP connectors, and web search are all listed as tool types an agent can use.

questions.q: How is a Cortex Agent invoked, per this lesson?
options: Through the agent:run REST API, passing the agent configuration and the user's message
Only through a desktop application with no API access
By editing a CSV file and re-uploading it manually
Agents cannot be invoked programmatically at all
questions.explain: Agents are invoked via the agent:run REST endpoint, which streams back planning steps, tool invocations, and the final answer.

questions.q: In the ticket-volume example in this lesson, why would an agent need more than one tool to answer well?
options: Because the question needs both a structured count (ticket volume over time) and a search over unstructured ticket text to identify complaint themes
Because Cortex Analyst alone can process both structured and unstructured data without any search tool
Because the question only requires a single translation call
Because Snowflake requires every question to use exactly three tools regardless of content
questions.explain: Answering 'did volume spike and what are customers complaining about' needs a structured query for volume and a search over ticket text for complaint themes.
